tools.name: backfill_legacy_join_tables
tools.description: Idempotently copy the signed-in user's legacy list memberships and project memberships into the stable-ID replacement tables. Safe to call before any other action; it never updates or deletes legacy rows.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO lead_list_memberships (id, lead_id, list_id, user_id, created_at) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), ll.lead_id, ll.list_id, ll.user_id, ll.created_at FROM lead_lists ll WHERE ll.user_id = :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM join_table_backfills b WHERE b.user_id = :__user_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO project_memberships (id, project_id, user_id, display_name, joined_at, created_at) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), pm.project_id, pm.user_id, pm.display_name, pm.joined_at, pm.joined_at FROM project_members pm JOIN projects p ON p.id = pm.project_id WHERE (pm.user_id = :__user_id OR p.user_id = :__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM join_table_backfills b WHERE b.user_id = :__user_id)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO join_table_backfills (id, user_id, created_at) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), :__user_id, :__now

tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: List the signed-in user's lead lists with the number of leads in each and the project each belongs to (project_id, null when none)
tools.sql: SELECT li.id, li.name, li.purpose, li.project_id, li.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_list_memberships ll WHERE ll.list_id = li.id) AS lead_count FROM lists li WHERE li.user_id = :__user_id AND (:project_id IS NULL OR li.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND li.project_id IS NULL)) ORDER BY li.name COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 500

project_id.description: Only lists in this project. 'none' = lists in no project

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create a lead list (a category of leads for one purpose or role) inside one of your projects. "changes": 0 means the project is not yours
tools.sql: INSERT INTO lists (id, user_id, name, purpose, project_id, created_at) SELECT :id, :__user_id, :name, :purpose, :project_id, :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.id = :project_id AND p.user_id = :__user_id)

project_id.description: Project the list belongs to (from list_projects) - required, every new list is in a project

tools.name: update_list
tools.description: Rename a lead list or change its purpose. "changes": 0 means the list is not in that project.
tools.sql: UPDATE lists SET name = :name, purpose = :purpose WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id AND (lists.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lists.project_id IS NULL))

project_id.description: Project the list belongs to (project_id from list_lists). 'none' for a list made before projects, that is in no project yet

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Delete a lead list. The leads themselves stay in the database. Nothing is deleted unless the list is in that project
statements: DELETE FROM lead_list_memberships WHERE list_id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lists lp WHERE lp.id = :id AND lp.user_id = :__user_id AND (lp.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lp.project_id IS NULL)))
DELETE FROM lists WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id AND (lists.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lists.project_id IS NULL))

UPDATE leads SET assigned_to_user_id = NULL WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND assigned_to_user_id IS NOT NULL AND assigned_to_user_id <> :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists li ON li.id = ll.list_id AND li.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = li.project_id AND pr.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN project_memberships pm ON pm.project_id = pr.id AND pm.user_id = leads.assigned_to_user_id WHERE ll.lead_id = leads.id)

project_id.description: Project the list belongs to (project_id from list_lists). 'none' for a list made before projects, that is in no project yet

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Projects the signed-in user owns (is_owner 1, with member_count) and projects they were invited to (is_owner 0, owner_name is who shared it). A project groups related lists
tools.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.owner_name, p.created_at, 1 AS is_owner, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_memberships pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.id) AS member_count FROM projects p WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.owner_name, p.created_at, 0 AS is_owner, NULL AS member_count FROM projects p JOIN project_memberships m ON m.project_id = p.id WHERE m.user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY is_owner DESC, name COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 500

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project - a group of related lists, e.g. one client or initiative. "changes": 0 means the name was empty
tools.sql: INSERT INTO projects (id, user_id, name, description, owner_name, created_at) SELECT :id, :__user_id, trim(:name), :description, :owner_name, :__now WHERE trim(:name) <> ''

owner_name.description: Your name as project members will see it

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Rename a project or change its description. Owner only. "changes": 0 means it is not your project or the name was empty
tools.sql: UPDATE projects SET name = trim(:name), description = :description WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id AND trim(:name) <> ''

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Delete an empty project. Owner only. A project that still has lists is not deleted - move them to another project (set_list_project) or delete them first. Its members and invites are removed, and leads assigned to a member who can no longer reach them are unassigned
statements: DELETE FROM project_invites WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lists WHERE project_id = :id)
DELETE FROM project_memberships WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lists WHERE project_id = :id)
DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lists WHERE project_id = :id)

UPDATE leads SET assigned_to_user_id = NULL WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND assigned_to_user_id IS NOT NULL AND assigned_to_user_id <> :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists li ON li.id = ll.list_id AND li.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = li.project_id AND pr.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN project_memberships pm ON pm.project_id = pr.id AND pm.user_id = leads.assigned_to_user_id WHERE ll.lead_id = leads.id)

tools.name: set_list_project
tools.description: Move a list into another of your projects. project_id is the project it is in now ('none' for a list made before projects), to_project_id the one it moves to. A list is always in a project, so it cannot be taken out of one. results[0].meta.changes is 0 when the list is not in project_id or to_project_id is not yours. Leads assigned to someone who loses access through this are unassigned
statements: UPDATE lists SET project_id = :to_project_id WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id AND (lists.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lists.project_id IS NULL)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.id = :to_project_id AND p.user_id = :__user_id)

UPDATE leads SET assigned_to_user_id = NULL WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND assigned_to_user_id IS NOT NULL AND assigned_to_user_id <> :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists li ON li.id = ll.list_id AND li.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = li.project_id AND pr.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN project_memberships pm ON pm.project_id = pr.id AND pm.user_id = leads.assigned_to_user_id WHERE ll.lead_id = leads.id)

project_id.description: Project the list belongs to (project_id from list_lists). 'none' for a list made before projects, that is in no project yet

to_project_id.description: Project to move the list to (from list_projects)

tools.name: list_project_members
tools.description: People who joined your projects (owner only), optionally for one project. user_id is what assign_lead takes
tools.sql: SELECT pm.project_id, pm.user_id, pm.display_name, pm.joined_at FROM project_memberships pm JOIN projects p ON p.id = pm.project_id WHERE p.user_id = :__user_id AND (:project_id IS NULL OR pm.project_id = :project_id) ORDER BY pm.display_name COLLATE NOCASE, pm.joined_at LIMIT 500

project_id.description: Only members of this project

tools.name: remove_project_member
tools.description: Remove someone from your project (owner only). Leads assigned to them that they can no longer reach are unassigned
statements: DELETE FROM project_memberships WHERE project_id = :project_id AND user_id = :user_id AND project_id IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE user_id = :__user_id)

UPDATE leads SET assigned_to_user_id = NULL WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND assigned_to_user_id IS NOT NULL AND assigned_to_user_id <> :__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists li ON li.id = ll.list_id AND li.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = li.project_id AND pr.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN project_memberships pm ON pm.project_id = pr.id AND pm.user_id = leads.assigned_to_user_id WHERE ll.lead_id = leads.id)

project_id.description: Project ID

tools.name: leave_project
tools.description: Leave a project you were invited to. Leads assigned to you that you can no longer reach are unassigned
statements: DELETE FROM project_memberships WHERE project_id = :project_id AND user_id = :__user_id

UPDATE leads SET assigned_to_user_id = NULL WHERE assigned_to_user_id = :__user_id AND user_id <> :__user_id AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM projects WHERE id = :project_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists li ON li.id = ll.list_id AND li.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = li.project_id AND pr.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN project_memberships pm ON pm.project_id = pr.id AND pm.user_id = :__user_id WHERE ll.lead_id = leads.id)

project_id.description: Project ID

tools.name: create_project_invite
tools.description: Create a single-use invite code for your project (owner only). It is random, expires after 7 days and is read back with list_project_invites. Share the link https://leads.proappstore.online/?join=<code>
tools.sql: INSERT INTO project_invites (code, project_id, created_by, expires_at, created_at) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), p.id, :__user_id, :__now + 604800000, :__now FROM projects p WHERE p.id = :project_id AND p.user_id = :__user_id

project_id.description: Project ID

tools.name: list_project_invites
tools.description: Open (unused, unexpired) invites of your project (owner only)
tools.sql: SELECT i.code, i.project_id, i.expires_at, i.created_at FROM project_invites i JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id WHERE i.project_id = :project_id AND p.user_id = :__user_id AND i.expires_at > :__now ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

project_id.description: Project ID

tools.name: revoke_project_invite
tools.description: Cancel an open invite of your project (owner only)
tools.sql: DELETE FROM project_invites WHERE code = :code AND project_id IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE user_id = :__user_id)

tools.name: get_project_invite
tools.description: Look up an invite code before joining: the project name and who shares it. No row means the code is wrong, used or expired
tools.sql: SELECT i.code, i.project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.owner_name, i.expires_at, CASE WHEN p.user_id = :__user_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_owner, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_memberships m WHERE m.project_id = p.id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AS is_member FROM project_invites i JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id WHERE i.code = :code AND i.expires_at > :__now

tools.name: join_project
tools.description: Join a project with an invite code. The code is used up. The owner can then assign leads to you, and list_assigned_leads shows them
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO project_memberships (id, project_id, user_id, display_name, joined_at, created_at) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), i.project_id, :__user_id, NULLIF(trim(:display_name), ''), :__now, :__now FROM project_invites i JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id WHERE i.code = :code AND i.expires_at > :__now AND p.user_id <> :__user_id
DELETE FROM project_invites WHERE code = :code AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_memberships pm WHERE pm.project_id = project_invites.project_id AND pm.user_id = :__user_id)

display_name.description: Your name as the project owner will see it

tools.name: list_leads
tools.description: Browse the signed-in user's leads, optionally filtered by list, status, or a search term, and sorted. list_ids is a comma-separated string of the lists each lead belongs to. last_message_at is the time of the most recent recorded message (epoch ms), null if none; last_reply_at is the time of the lead's most recent message to the user (direction 'in'), null if they never replied. needs_attention is 1 when the lead is flagged for the owner, with attention_reason and attention_at. Leads that need attention are always listed first, then the chosen sort applies. source_name / source_kind / source_link describe the lead's source. assigned_to_user_id is who the lead is assigned to (null when nobody). tags is a JSON array of tags, custom_fields a JSON object of your own fields, next_action_at / next_action the scheduled follow-up (epoch ms / what to do)
tools.sql: SELECT l.id, l.user_id, l.name, l.title, l.company, l.email, l.phone, l.website, l.location, l.linkedin, l.twitter, l.instagram, l.facebook, l.tiktok, l.youtube, l.github, l.status, l.notes, l.created_at, l.updated_at, l.source, l.fit, l.source_url, l.found_at, l.needs_attention, l.attention_reason, l.attention_at, l.source_id, l.country, l.assigned_to_user_id, l.tags, l.custom_fields, l.next_action_at, l.next_action, (SELECT s.name FROM sources s WHERE s.id = l.source_id) AS source_name, (SELECT s.kind FROM sources s WHERE s.id = l.source_id) AS source_kind, (SELECT s.url FROM sources s WHERE s.id = l.source_id) AS source_link, (SELECT group_concat(ll.list_id) FROM lead_list_memberships ll WHERE ll.lead_id = l.id) AS list_ids, (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id) AS last_message_at, (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id AND m.direction = 'in') AS last_reply_at FROM leads l WHERE l.user_id = :__user_id AND (:list_id IS NULL OR (l.id IN (SELECT lead_id FROM lead_list_memberships WHERE list_id = :list_id AND user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lists lp WHERE lp.id = :list_id AND lp.user_id = :__user_id AND (lp.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lp.project_id IS NULL))))) AND (:project_id IS NULL OR l.id IN (SELECT ll.lead_id FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists li ON li.id = ll.list_id WHERE (li.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND li.project_id IS NULL)) AND li.user_id = :__user_id)) AND (:assigned_to IS NULL OR l.assigned_to_user_id = CASE WHEN :assigned_to = 'me' THEN :__user_id ELSE :assigned_to END OR (:assigned_to = 'none' AND l.assigned_to_user_id IS NULL)) AND (:tag IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(COALESCE(l.tags, '[]')) tg WHERE tg.value = :tag COLLATE NOCASE)) AND (:follow_up IS NULL OR (:follow_up = 'due' AND l.next_action_at <= COALESCE(:due_before, :__now) AND l.status NOT IN ('won', 'lost')) OR (:follow_up = 'scheduled' AND l.next_action_at IS NOT NULL) OR (:follow_up = 'none' AND l.next_action_at IS NULL AND l.status NOT IN ('won', 'lost'))) AND (:status IS NULL OR l.status = :status) AND (:fit IS NULL OR l.fit = :fit) AND (:country IS NULL OR l.country = upper(:country) OR (:country = 'none' AND l.country IS NULL)) AND (:source_id IS NULL OR l.source_id = :source_id OR (:source_id = 'none' AND l.source_id IS NULL)) AND (:needs_attention IS NULL OR l.needs_attention = :needs_attention) AND (:q IS NULL OR l.name LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR l.company LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR (SELECT s.name FROM sources s WHERE s.id = l.source_id) LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR l.title LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR l.email LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR l.phone LIKE '%' || :q || '%') ORDER BY l.needs_attention DESC, CASE WHEN :dir = 'desc' THEN NULL ELSE CASE :sort WHEN 'email' THEN l.email WHEN 'status' THEN (CASE l.status WHEN 'new' THEN 0 WHEN 'contacted' THEN 1 WHEN 'replied' THEN 2 WHEN 'qualified' THEN 3 WHEN 'won' THEN 4 WHEN 'lost' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END) WHEN 'last_contact' THEN (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id) WHEN 'last_reply' THEN (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id AND m.direction = 'in') WHEN 'fit' THEN (CASE l.fit WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'med' THEN 1 WHEN 'low' THEN 2 END) WHEN 'attention' THEN l.attention_at WHEN 'next_action' THEN l.next_action_at WHEN 'found' THEN l.found_at WHEN 'created' THEN l.created_at WHEN 'updated' THEN l.updated_at ELSE l.name END END COLLATE NOCASE ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN :dir = 'desc' THEN CASE :sort WHEN 'email' THEN l.email WHEN 'status' THEN (CASE l.status WHEN 'new' THEN 0 WHEN 'contacted' THEN 1 WHEN 'replied' THEN 2 WHEN 'qualified' THEN 3 WHEN 'won' THEN 4 WHEN 'lost' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END) WHEN 'last_contact' THEN (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id) WHEN 'last_reply' THEN (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id AND m.direction = 'in') WHEN 'fit' THEN (CASE l.fit WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'med' THEN 1 WHEN 'low' THEN 2 END) WHEN 'attention' THEN l.attention_at WHEN 'next_action' THEN l.next_action_at WHEN 'found' THEN l.found_at WHEN 'created' THEN l.created_at WHEN 'updated' THEN l.updated_at ELSE l.name END END COLLATE NOCASE DESC NULLS LAST, l.name COLLATE NOCASE, l.id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

list_id.description: Only leads in this list - give its project_id too, a list_id without its matching project_id returns no leads

project_id.description: Only leads in the lists of this project ('none' = lists in no project). Required with list_id: the project that list is in

assigned_to.description: Only leads assigned to this user ID (from list_project_members). 'me' = assigned to you, 'none' = assigned to nobody

fit.description: Only leads with this fit: high, med or low

country.description: Only leads in this country (2-letter ISO code). 'none' = leads whose country is not confirmed yet

source_id.description: Only leads from this source (ID from list_sources). 'none' = leads with no source

needs_attention.description: true = only leads marked as needing the owner's attention, false = only unmarked leads

q.description: Search name, company, title, email, phone, source name

follow_up.description: 'due' = follow-up date reached (not won/lost), 'scheduled' = has a follow-up, 'none' = open lead with no follow-up set

due_before.description: For follow_up 'due': cutoff in epoch ms, e.g. the end of today. Defaults to now

sort.description: Sort by name, email, status (pipeline order), fit (high first), next_action (soonest follow-up first), last_contact, last_reply, attention (when it was flagged), found, created, or updated (most recently changed)

dir.description: asc or desc. Leads with no value always sort last

tools.name: count_leads
tools.description: Total number of leads in the signed-in user's database, how many are marked as needing attention, how many have no source, and how many leads (yours or shared with you) are assigned to you, and how many open leads have a follow-up due (follow_ups_due) Narrowed to one project with project_id.

due_before.description: Cutoff for follow_ups_due in epoch ms, e.g. the end of today. Defaults to now

tools.name: find_lead
tools.description: Check whether a person is ALREADY in the database before adding them. Exact, case-insensitive match on any of: email, phone, a profile or website URL, or full name. Returns the matching leads (usually 0 or 1). Pass at least one parameter.

tools.name: assign_lead
tools.description: Assign one of your leads to a person, or unassign it with user_id null. The person must be you (user_id me) or a member (list_project_members) of a project that has a list the lead is in - they then see the lead with list_assigned_leads. "changes": 0 means the lead is not yours or that person is not in such a project Recorded in the lead history (get_lead_history).
tools.sql: UPDATE leads SET assigned_to_user_id = p.assignee, updated_at = p.now, history = CASE WHEN json_patch('{}', json_object('assigned_to_user_id', json(CASE WHEN leads.assigned_to_user_id IS NOT p.assignee THEN json_array(leads.assigned_to_user_id, p.assignee) END))) = '{}' THEN leads.history ELSE json_insert(CASE WHEN json_array_length(COALESCE(leads.history, '[]')) >= 300 THEN json_remove(COALESCE(leads.history, '[]'), '$[0]') ELSE COALESCE(leads.history, '[]') END, '$[#]', json(json_object('at', p.now, 'by', p.uid, 'via', 'assign_lead', 'changes', json(json_patch('{}', json_object('assigned_to_user_id', json(CASE WHEN leads.assigned_to_user_id IS NOT p.assignee THEN json_array(leads.assigned_to_user_id, p.assignee) END))))))) END FROM (SELECT :id AS id, :__user_id AS uid, :__now AS now, CASE WHEN :user_id = 'me' THEN :__user_id ELSE :user_id END AS assignee) AS p WHERE leads.id = p.id AND leads.user_id = p.uid AND (p.assignee IS NULL OR p.assignee = p.uid OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists li ON li.id = ll.list_id AND li.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = li.project_id AND pr.user_id = leads.user_id JOIN project_memberships pm ON pm.project_id = pr.id AND pm.user_id = p.assignee WHERE ll.lead_id = leads.id))

tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Add a NEW lead (contact). Call find_lead first if the person may already be in the database. country is REQUIRED and must be confirmed, not guessed. LINKS ONLY - every social profile field (linkedin, twitter, instagram, facebook, tiktok, youtube, github) must be the full https:// URL of the profile on that platform, or null when unknown. Never a person's name, a handle or a label. The result shows "changes": 1 when saved. "changes": 0 means NOTHING was saved, because (a) a social field or source_url is not a valid https:// link - call check_lead_links, (b) country is missing or not a 2-letter ISO code, status or fit is not an allowed value, or source_id is not one of your sources, or (c) another lead already has the same email or profile URL - call find_lead and use that lead instead.

id.description: New random UUID v4 for the lead - generate it, do not hand-write a pattern

title.description: The lead's job title or the role they are looking for. Not their fit, not HOT flags

company.description: The lead's employer or own business. NOT the group or place where you found them - that is source

source_id.description: ID of the source - the group, page or event where the lead was found. Find it with list_sources, add a missing one with create_source. The lead is NOT saved if the id is not one of your sources

source_url.description: https:// link to the exact post, comment, thread or page where the lead was found, so a human can open it

country.description: Country the lead is CONFIRMED to be in, as a 2-letter ISO 3166 code (AU, NZ, GB, US...). Only set it when the person's profile, post or conversation shows it - never guess from a group's name or the language they write in. REQUIRED - the lead is not saved without it.

instagram.description: Instagram profile LINK - the full URL starting with https:// on instagram.com, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/janedoe. NOT the person's name and NOT a handle. Send null if you do not have the URL

facebook.description: Facebook profile LINK - the full URL starting with https:// on facebook.com or fb.com or fb.me, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/jane.doe. NOT the person's name and NOT a handle. Send null if you do not have the URL

tiktok.description: TikTok profile LINK - the full URL starting with https:// on tiktok.com, e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/@janedoe. NOT the person's name and NOT a handle. Send null if you do not have the URL

tools.name: enrich_lead
tools.description: Add information to an existing lead WITHOUT touching anything else. Only the fields you pass are considered, and by default only EMPTY fields are filled - pass overwrite true to change values that are already set. append_note adds a line to the notes and never removes existing notes. LINKS ONLY - every social profile field (linkedin, twitter, instagram, facebook, tiktok, youtube, github) must be the full https:// URL of the profile on that platform, or null when unknown. Never a person's name, a handle or a label. The result shows "changes": 1 when saved. "changes": 0 means NOTHING was saved, because (a) a social field or source_url is not a valid https:// link - call check_lead_links, (b) country is not a 2-letter ISO code, status or fit is not an allowed value, or source_id is not one of your sources, or (c) another lead already has the same email or profile URL - call find_lead and use that lead instead. "changes": 0 can also mean the id does not exist. Recorded in the lead history (get_lead_history).

tools.name: set_lead_status
tools.description: Change only the pipeline status of a lead. Keep it in step with the conversation - contacted once you have written, replied once the lead has answered. "changes": 0 means the id does not exist or the status is not an allowed value. Also works on a lead assigned to you in a project you joined. Recorded in the lead history (get_lead_history).

Also works on a lead assigned to you in a project you joined. "changes": 0 means the lead is not yours. Recorded in the lead history (get_lead_history).

action.description: What to do next, e.g. "Call about the demo"

tools.name: add_note

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the places leads were found (Facebook groups, pages, events...) with performance stats per source: leads, contacted (status past new or any message recorded), replied (answered - status or an inbound message), qualified (qualified or won), won, high_fit, needs_attention, reply_rate_pct (replied / contacted, null when nobody was contacted) and last_found_at. Use q to look a source up by name or by its url before creating it. count_leads gives the number of leads with no source.. A source is shared by all your projects; with project_id the counts only include that project's leads
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT x.*, CASE WHEN x.contacted > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * x.replied / x.contacted) END AS reply_rate_pct FROM (SELECT s.id, s.name, s.kind, s.url, s.notes, s.created_at, COUNT(l.id) AS leads, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status <> 'new' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS contacted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('replied', 'qualified', 'won') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id AND m.direction = 'in') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS replied, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('qualified', 'won') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS qualified, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.fit = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS high_fit, COALESCE(SUM(l.needs_attention), 0) AS needs_attention, MAX(l.found_at) AS last_found_at FROM sources s LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.source_id = s.id AND l.user_id = s.user_id AND (:project_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships pll JOIN lists pli ON pli.id = pll.list_id AND pli.user_id = l.user_id WHERE pll.lead_id = l.id AND (pli.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND pli.project_id IS NULL)))) WHERE s.user_id = :__user_id AND (:q IS NULL OR s.name LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR lower(rtrim(s.url, '/')) = lower(rtrim(:q, '/'))) GROUP BY s.id) AS x) AS y ORDER BY CASE WHEN :sort = 'name' THEN y.name END COLLATE NOCASE ASC, CASE :sort WHEN 'name' THEN NULL WHEN 'reply_rate' THEN y.reply_rate_pct WHEN 'won' THEN y.won WHEN 'high_fit' THEN y.high_fit WHEN 'last_found' THEN y.last_found_at ELSE y.leads END DESC NULLS LAST, y.name COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 500

sort.description: leads (most first, default), reply_rate, won, high_fit, last_found (most recent first) or name

project_id.description: Only leads in this project's lists ('none' = lists made before projects). Leave it out for every project

tools.description: Get one source by ID with everything known about it: name, kind, url, notes, created_at, the same stats as list_sources (leads, contacted, replied, reply_rate_pct, qualified, won, high_fit, needs_attention), a count of its leads per status (status_new, status_contacted, status_replied, status_qualified, status_won, status_lost), first_found_at, last_found_at and last_contact_at. Its leads themselves come from list_leads with this source_id. Change it with update_source.. A source is shared by all your projects; with project_id the counts only include that project's leads
tools.sql: SELECT x.*, CASE WHEN x.contacted > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * x.replied / x.contacted) END AS reply_rate_pct FROM (SELECT s.id, s.name, s.kind, s.url, s.notes, s.created_at, COUNT(l.id) AS leads, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status <> 'new' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS contacted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('replied', 'qualified', 'won') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id AND m.direction = 'in') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS replied, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('qualified', 'won') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS qualified, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.fit = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS high_fit, COALESCE(SUM(l.needs_attention), 0) AS needs_attention, MAX(l.found_at) AS last_found_at, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'new' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_new, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'contacted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_contacted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'replied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_replied, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'qualified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_qualified, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_won, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_lost, MIN(l.found_at) AS first_found_at, MAX((SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id)) AS last_contact_at FROM sources s LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.source_id = s.id AND l.user_id = s.user_id AND (:project_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships pll JOIN lists pli ON pli.id = pll.list_id AND pli.user_id = l.user_id WHERE pll.lead_id = l.id AND (pli.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND pli.project_id IS NULL)))) WHERE s.id = :id AND s.user_id = :__user_id GROUP BY s.id) AS x

project_id.description: Only leads in this project's lists ('none' = lists made before projects). Leave it out for every project

tools.name: create_source
tools.description: Add a place where leads are found - a Facebook group, page, event, website... Call list_sources with q first: names are unique (case-insensitive) and so are urls. "changes": 0 means nothing was saved - a source with that name or url already exists (use its id), kind is not an allowed value, the name is empty, or url is not an https:// link.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO sources (id, user_id, name, kind, url, notes, created_at) SELECT p.id, p.uid, trim(p.name), p.kind, NULLIF(p.url, ''), p.notes, p.now FROM (SELECT :id AS id, :__user_id AS uid, :__now AS now, :name AS name, :kind AS kind, :url AS url, :notes AS notes) AS p WHERE trim(p.name) <> '' AND p.kind IN ('Facebook group', 'Facebook page', 'Instagram', 'LinkedIn group', 'Reddit', 'Telegram group', 'WhatsApp group', 'Discord', 'Website', 'Event', 'Referral', 'Other') AND (p.url IS NULL OR p.url = '' OR (p.url LIKE 'https://_%' AND p.url NOT LIKE '% %')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources d WHERE d.user_id = p.uid AND (d.name = trim(p.name) COLLATE NOCASE OR (p.url IS NOT NULL AND p.url <> '' AND lower(rtrim(d.url, '/')) = lower(rtrim(p.url, '/')))))

id.description: New random UUID v4 for the source

name.description: Name of the group, page or event as it appears there, without a 'Facebook group:' prefix - that is kind

kind.description: What kind of place it is. One of: Facebook group, Facebook page, Instagram, LinkedIn group, Reddit, Telegram group, WhatsApp group, Discord, Website, Event, Referral, Other

url.description: https:// link to the group, page or event itself (e.g. https://www.facebook.com/groups/melbournecasualjobs) - not to a single post

notes.description: Size, rules, who runs it, anything worth knowing

tools.name: update_source
tools.description: Change a source. Only the fields you pass change; pass an empty string to clear url or notes. "changes": 0 means nothing was saved - unknown id, another source already has that name or url, kind not allowed, or url not an https:// link.
tools.sql: UPDATE sources SET name = COALESCE(trim(p.name), sources.name), kind = COALESCE(p.kind, sources.kind), url = CASE WHEN p.url IS NULL THEN sources.url WHEN p.url = '' THEN NULL ELSE p.url END, notes = CASE WHEN p.notes IS NULL THEN sources.notes WHEN p.notes = '' THEN NULL ELSE p.notes END FROM (SELECT :id AS id, :__user_id AS uid, :name AS name, :kind AS kind, :url AS url, :notes AS notes) AS p WHERE sources.id = p.id AND sources.user_id = p.uid AND (p.name IS NULL OR trim(p.name) <> '') AND (p.kind IS NULL OR p.kind IN ('Facebook group', 'Facebook page', 'Instagram', 'LinkedIn group', 'Reddit', 'Telegram group', 'WhatsApp group', 'Discord', 'Website', 'Event', 'Referral', 'Other')) AND (p.url IS NULL OR p.url = '' OR (p.url LIKE 'https://_%' AND p.url NOT LIKE '% %')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources d WHERE d.user_id = p.uid AND d.id <> p.id AND ((p.name IS NOT NULL AND d.name = trim(p.name) COLLATE NOCASE) OR (p.url IS NOT NULL AND p.url <> '' AND lower(rtrim(d.url, '/')) = lower(rtrim(p.url, '/')))))

kind.description: What kind of place it is. One of: Facebook group, Facebook page, Instagram, LinkedIn group, Reddit, Telegram group, WhatsApp group, Discord, Website, Event, Referral, Other

url.description: https:// link to the group, page or event itself (e.g. https://www.facebook.com/groups/melbournecasualjobs) - not to a single post. Empty string clears it

notes.description: New notes. Empty string clears them

tools.name: delete_source
tools.description: Delete a source. Its leads stay in the database and simply have no source afterwards
statements: UPDATE leads SET source_id = NULL, updated_at = :__now WHERE source_id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM sources WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: assign_leads_to_source
tools.description: Set the source of one or many leads in one call - replaces whatever source they had. "changes" is the number of leads updated. "changes": 0 means source_id is not one of your sources, or none of the lead ids exist.
tools.sql: UPDATE leads SET source_id = NULLIF(:source_id, 'none'), updated_at = :__now WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:lead_ids) THEN :lead_ids ELSE '[]' END)) AND (:source_id = 'none' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources s WHERE s.id = :source_id AND s.user_id = :__user_id))

source_id.description: Source ID from list_sources, or 'none' to remove the source from these leads

lead_ids.description: JSON array of lead IDs, e.g. ["id1","id2"]

tools.name: add_lead_to_list
tools.description: Put a lead in a list. A lead can be in many lists. "changes": 0 means the list is not in that project.
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO lead_list_memberships (id, lead_id, list_id, user_id, created_at) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), l.id, li.id, :__user_id, :__now FROM leads l, lists li WHERE l.id = :lead_id AND li.id = :list_id AND l.user_id = :__user_id AND li.user_id = :__user_id AND (li.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND li.project_id IS NULL))

project_id.description: Project the list belongs to (project_id from list_lists). 'none' for a list made before projects, that is in no project yet

tools.name: remove_lead_from_list
tools.description: Take a lead out of a list. The lead stays in the database. "changes": 0 means the list is not in that project.
tools.sql: DELETE FROM lead_list_memberships WHERE lead_id = :lead_id AND list_id = :list_id AND user_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lists lp WHERE lp.id = :list_id AND lp.user_id = :__user_id AND (lp.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lp.project_id IS NULL)))

project_id.description: Project the list belongs to (project_id from list_lists). 'none' for a list made before projects, that is in no project yet

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Read the recorded conversation with a lead, oldest first. Every message has its exact time (occurred_at, epoch ms), platform, direction ('in' from the lead, 'out' to the lead) and full body. Page with offset to read everything. Also works on a lead assigned to you in a project you joined
tools.sql: SELECT m.id, m.lead_id, m.platform, m.direction, m.body, m.occurred_at, m.created_at FROM messages m JOIN leads l ON l.id = m.lead_id AND l.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.lead_id = :lead_id AND (l.user_id = :__user_id OR (l.assigned_to_user_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists li ON li.id = ll.list_id AND li.user_id = l.user_id JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = li.project_id AND pr.user_id = l.user_id JOIN project_memberships pm ON pm.project_id = pr.id AND pm.user_id = :__user_id WHERE ll.lead_id = l.id))) AND (:platform IS NULL OR m.platform = :platform) ORDER BY m.occurred_at, m.seq, m.created_at LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: add_messages
tools.description: Record a whole conversation thread with a lead in ONE call. messages is a JSON array, in the order the messages were sent; array order is kept even when several messages share the same minute. SAFE TO REPEAT - messages already stored for this lead (same direction, same occurred_at, same body) are skipped, so re-sending a thread only adds what is new. Genuine repeats in one thread (the same text sent twice in the same minute) are kept. "changes" is the number of messages stored. If ANY item is malformed (direction not 'in'/'out', empty body, occurred_at not an integer, platform not allowed) NOTHING is stored. Give each message its own real occurred_at - do not stamp a whole thread with one time. Also works on a lead assigned to you in a project you joined.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO messages (id, user_id, lead_id, platform, direction, body, occurred_at, seq, created_at) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), l.user_id, l.id, COALESCE(json_extract(j.value, '$.platform'), :platform), json_extract(j.value, '$.direction'), json_extract(j.value, '$.body'), json_extract(j.value, '$.occurred_at'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages c WHERE c.lead_id = l.id) + j.key, :__now FROM leads l, json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:messages) THEN :messages ELSE '[]' END) AS j WHERE l.id = :lead_id AND (l.user_id = :__user_id OR (l.assigned_to_user_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists li ON li.id = ll.list_id AND li.user_id = l.user_id JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = li.project_id AND pr.user_id = l.user_id JOIN project_memberships pm ON pm.project_id = pr.id AND pm.user_id = :__user_id WHERE ll.lead_id = l.id))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:messages) THEN :messages ELSE '[]' END) AS b WHERE json_extract(b.value, '$.direction') IS NULL OR json_extract(b.value, '$.direction') NOT IN ('in', 'out') OR json_extract(b.value, '$.body') IS NULL OR trim(json_extract(b.value, '$.body')) = '' OR typeof(json_extract(b.value, '$.occurred_at')) <> 'integer' OR COALESCE(json_extract(b.value, '$.platform'), :platform) IS NULL OR COALESCE(json_extract(b.value, '$.platform'), :platform) NOT IN ('LinkedIn', 'Email', 'X', 'Instagram', 'Facebook', 'Messenger', 'TikTok', 'YouTube', 'WhatsApp', 'Telegram', 'SMS', 'Phone call', 'In person', 'Other')) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:messages) THEN :messages ELSE '[]' END) AS c2 WHERE c2.key <= j.key AND json_extract(c2.value, '$.direction') = json_extract(j.value, '$.direction') AND json_extract(c2.value, '$.occurred_at') = json_extract(j.value, '$.occurred_at') AND json_extract(c2.value, '$.body') = json_extract(j.value, '$.body')) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages e WHERE e.lead_id = l.id AND e.direction = json_extract(j.value, '$.direction') AND e.occurred_at = json_extract(j.value, '$.occurred_at') AND e.body = json_extract(j.value, '$.body'))

platform.description: Where it happened. One of: LinkedIn, Email, X, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, Phone call, In person, Other. Applies to every message that has no platform of its own

messages.description: JSON array of messages in sending order, e.g. [{"direction":"out","occurred_at":1789735980000,"body":"Hi Kai"},{"direction":"in","occurred_at":1789880460000,"body":"Tell me more"}]. direction: 'out' = sent by the user, 'in' = sent by the lead. occurred_at: exact send time, Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC). Optional per-message platform

tools.name: add_message
tools.description: Record ONE message of a conversation with a lead. To record a whole thread use add_messages - one call, and safe to repeat. "changes": 0 means nothing was saved - unknown lead_id, platform not in the allowed list, direction not 'in' or 'out', or an empty body. Also works on a lead assigned to you in a project you joined.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO messages (id, user_id, lead_id, platform, direction, body, occurred_at, seq, created_at) SELECT :id, l.user_id, l.id, :platform, :direction, :body, :occurred_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages c WHERE c.lead_id = l.id), :__now FROM leads l WHERE l.id = :lead_id AND (l.user_id = :__user_id OR (l.assigned_to_user_id = :__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists li ON li.id = ll.list_id AND li.user_id = l.user_id JOIN projects pr ON pr.id = li.project_id AND pr.user_id = l.user_id JOIN project_memberships pm ON pm.project_id = pr.id AND pm.user_id = :__user_id WHERE ll.lead_id = l.id))) AND :platform IN ('LinkedIn', 'Email', 'X', 'Instagram', 'Facebook', 'Messenger', 'TikTok', 'YouTube', 'WhatsApp', 'Telegram', 'SMS', 'Phone call', 'In person', 'Other') AND :direction IN ('in', 'out') AND trim(:body) <> ''

platform.description: Where it happened. One of: LinkedIn, Email, X, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, Phone call, In person, Other

direction.description: 'out' if the signed-in user sent it, 'in' if the lead sent it

occurred_at.description: Exact time the message was sent, as Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC)

tools.name: update_message
tools.description: Correct a recorded message
tools.sql: UPDATE messages SET platform = :platform, direction = :direction, body = :body, occurred_at = :occurred_at WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id AND :platform IN ('LinkedIn', 'Email', 'X', 'Instagram', 'Facebook', 'Messenger', 'TikTok', 'YouTube', 'WhatsApp', 'Telegram', 'SMS', 'Phone call', 'In person', 'Other') AND :direction IN ('in', 'out') AND trim(:body) <> ''

platform.description: Where it happened. One of: LinkedIn, Email, X, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, Phone call, In person, Other

direction.description: 'out' if the signed-in user sent it, 'in' if the lead sent it

occurred_at.description: Exact time the message was sent, as Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC)

tools.description: Delete a recorded message
tools.sql: DELETE FROM messages WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: stats_timeline
tools.description: Activity counts per time bucket, for charts and for checking what agents did in a period. buckets is a JSON array of [start, end) pairs in epoch ms - one row comes back per pair, in order. Per bucket: leads_added (by created_at, when the lead was saved), messages_sent / messages_received (by occurred_at, when the message was really sent), leads_replied (distinct leads with an inbound message), sources_added, flagged (leads whose current needs-attention flag was raised then). source_id / list_id narrow every lead-based count - sources_added is never filtered.
tools.sql: SELECT j.key AS i, json_extract(j.value, '$[0]') AS start_at, json_extract(j.value, '$[1]') AS end_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads l WHERE l.user_id = :__user_id AND l.created_at >= json_extract(j.value, '$[0]') AND l.created_at < json_extract(j.value, '$[1]') AND (:source_id IS NULL OR l.source_id = :source_id OR (:source_id = 'none' AND l.source_id IS NULL)) AND (:project_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships pll JOIN lists pli ON pli.id = pll.list_id AND pli.user_id = l.user_id WHERE pll.lead_id = l.id AND (pli.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND pli.project_id IS NULL)))) AND (:list_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists lp ON lp.id = ll.list_id WHERE ll.lead_id = l.id AND ll.list_id = :list_id AND (lp.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lp.project_id IS NULL))))) AS leads_added, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN leads l ON l.id = m.lead_id WHERE m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.direction = 'out' AND m.occurred_at >= json_extract(j.value, '$[0]') AND m.occurred_at < json_extract(j.value, '$[1]') AND (:source_id IS NULL OR l.source_id = :source_id OR (:source_id = 'none' AND l.source_id IS NULL)) AND (:project_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships pll JOIN lists pli ON pli.id = pll.list_id AND pli.user_id = l.user_id WHERE pll.lead_id = l.id AND (pli.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND pli.project_id IS NULL)))) AND (:list_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists lp ON lp.id = ll.list_id WHERE ll.lead_id = l.id AND ll.list_id = :list_id AND (lp.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lp.project_id IS NULL))))) AS messages_sent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN leads l ON l.id = m.lead_id WHERE m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.direction = 'in' AND m.occurred_at >= json_extract(j.value, '$[0]') AND m.occurred_at < json_extract(j.value, '$[1]') AND (:source_id IS NULL OR l.source_id = :source_id OR (:source_id = 'none' AND l.source_id IS NULL)) AND (:project_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships pll JOIN lists pli ON pli.id = pll.list_id AND pli.user_id = l.user_id WHERE pll.lead_id = l.id AND (pli.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND pli.project_id IS NULL)))) AND (:list_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists lp ON lp.id = ll.list_id WHERE ll.lead_id = l.id AND ll.list_id = :list_id AND (lp.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lp.project_id IS NULL))))) AS messages_received, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.lead_id) FROM messages m JOIN leads l ON l.id = m.lead_id WHERE m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.direction = 'in' AND m.occurred_at >= json_extract(j.value, '$[0]') AND m.occurred_at < json_extract(j.value, '$[1]') AND (:source_id IS NULL OR l.source_id = :source_id OR (:source_id = 'none' AND l.source_id IS NULL)) AND (:project_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships pll JOIN lists pli ON pli.id = pll.list_id AND pli.user_id = l.user_id WHERE pll.lead_id = l.id AND (pli.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND pli.project_id IS NULL)))) AND (:list_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists lp ON lp.id = ll.list_id WHERE ll.lead_id = l.id AND ll.list_id = :list_id AND (lp.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lp.project_id IS NULL))))) AS leads_replied, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sources s WHERE s.user_id = :__user_id AND s.created_at >= json_extract(j.value, '$[0]') AND s.created_at < json_extract(j.value, '$[1]')) AS sources_added, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads l WHERE l.user_id = :__user_id AND l.attention_at >= json_extract(j.value, '$[0]') AND l.attention_at < json_extract(j.value, '$[1]') AND (:source_id IS NULL OR l.source_id = :source_id OR (:source_id = 'none' AND l.source_id IS NULL)) AND (:project_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships pll JOIN lists pli ON pli.id = pll.list_id AND pli.user_id = l.user_id WHERE pll.lead_id = l.id AND (pli.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND pli.project_id IS NULL)))) AND (:list_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists lp ON lp.id = ll.list_id WHERE ll.lead_id = l.id AND ll.list_id = :list_id AND (lp.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lp.project_id IS NULL))))) AS flagged FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:buckets) THEN :buckets ELSE '[]' END) AS j ORDER BY j.key LIMIT 400

source_id.description: Only leads from this source (ID from list_sources). 'none' = leads with no source

project_id.description: Only leads in this project's lists ('none' = lists made before projects). Required with list_id: the project that list is in, which otherwise counts nothing

tools.name: stats_pipeline
tools.description: Where the leads are right now: total, a count per status (status_new ... status_lost), per fit (fit_high, fit_med, fit_low, fit_none), needs_attention, with_conversation (leads with at least one recorded message) and replied (leads with an inbound message). Narrow with source_id and list_id.
tools.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'new' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_new, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'contacted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_contacted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'replied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_replied, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'qualified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_qualified, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_won, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS status_lost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.fit = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fit_high, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.fit = 'med' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fit_med, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.fit = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fit_low, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.fit IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fit_none, COALESCE(SUM(l.needs_attention), 0) AS needs_attention, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS with_conversation, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id AND m.direction = 'in') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS replied FROM leads l WHERE l.user_id = :__user_id AND (:source_id IS NULL OR l.source_id = :source_id OR (:source_id = 'none' AND l.source_id IS NULL)) AND (:project_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships pll JOIN lists pli ON pli.id = pll.list_id AND pli.user_id = l.user_id WHERE pll.lead_id = l.id AND (pli.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND pli.project_id IS NULL)))) AND (:list_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships ll JOIN lists lp ON lp.id = ll.list_id WHERE ll.lead_id = l.id AND ll.list_id = :list_id AND (lp.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND lp.project_id IS NULL))))

source_id.description: Only leads from this source (ID from list_sources). 'none' = leads with no source

project_id.description: Only leads in this project's lists ('none' = lists made before projects). Required with list_id: the project that list is in, which otherwise counts nothing

tools.name: recent_activity
tools.description: What happened, newest first, each item at the time it happened: leads added (lead_added), every recorded change to a lead (lead_changed - detail is a JSON object of field: [old, new]), notes (lead_note), messages recorded, leads flagged and sources added. at is the event's own time; at_known is 0 for an old entry whose time was never recorded, where at falls back to the lead's creation. Changes and notes come from the lead history, which starts when history was added to the app - older edits are not in it. Can be narrowed to one source, and with project_id to one project (sources, which belong to no project, then drop out)
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'lead_added' AS kind, l.created_at AS at, 1 AS at_known, l.id AS lead_id, l.name AS lead_name, (SELECT s.name FROM sources s WHERE s.id = l.source_id) AS source_name, l.title AS detail, 'a:' || l.id AS k FROM leads l WHERE l.user_id = :__user_id AND (:project_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_list_memberships pll JOIN lists pli ON pli.id = pll.list_id AND pli.user_id = l.user_id WHERE pll.lead_id = l.id AND (pli.project_id = :project_id OR (:project_id = 'none' AND pli.project_id IS NULL)))) AND (:source_id IS NULL OR l.source_id = :source_id OR (:source_id = 'none' AND l.source_id IS NULL)) UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN json_extract(h.value, '$.note') IS NOT NULL THEN 'lead_note' ELSE 'lead_changed' END, COALESCE(json_extract(h.value, '$.at'), l.created_at), CASE WHEN json_extract(h.value, '$.at') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, l.id, l.name, (SELECT s.name FROM sources s WHERE s.id = l.source_id), COALESCE(json_extract(h.value, '$.note'), before.description: For paging: the at of the last event you received

source_id.description: Only leads from this source (ID from list_sources). 'none' = leads with no source

before_k.description: For paging: the k of the last event you received, together with before - so events sharing a timestamp are not skipped

project_id.description: Only leads in this project's lists ('none' = lists made before projects). Leave it out for every project

tools.name: delete_my_data
tools.description: Delete EVERYTHING this account holds in Leads, permanently, in one transaction: your leads (with every message on them, their tags, custom fields and list memberships), your lists, your sources, the projects you own (with their invites and memberships), your memberships in other people's projects, and invites you created. Other members' leads that were assigned to you are unassigned and their lists attached to a project you owned are detached - never deleted. Nothing is retained afterwards and there is no undo. Requires confirm to be exactly the text DELETE MY DATA; any other value changes nothing and reports 0 changes on every statement. This does NOT delete your ProAppStore account itself (platform identity, usage and analytics aggregates, error logs - the platform prunes logs after 30 days and usage after 90): ask support@proappstore.online for that.
